title: find-callees
summary: Lists the resolved outgoing calls of one routine
intro: Read this when you want to know what a routine actually calls, resolved through the index rather than by reading its source. find-callees --qname Foo.Bar lists its outgoing calls; add --json for machine-readable output.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint find-callees --qname <Foo.Bar> --db PATH [--json] (resolved outgoing calls of routine X)
help: drag-lint find-callees --qname <Foo.Bar> --db PATH [--json]   (resolved outgoing calls of routine X)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > What This Routine Calls (callees)...
steps: Needs an index of the project
drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > What This Routine Calls (callees)...
Enter or confirm the routine; its resolved outgoing calls are listed

questions.ask: Can I get the outgoing calls as JSON?
